policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Both reports identify deterministic concurrency gaps. An OPEN position remains claimable until after broadcast, while pending nonces are independently fetched without durable or wallet-scoped serialization. This permits duplicate exits, nonce collisions, replacement, and uncertain ordering.
required_tests: Race two close_position callers and assert exactly one broadcast
Crash after broadcast and verify restart reconciliation
test_live_executor_concurrent_nonce_assignment
decisions.title: EVM exits lack atomic position claims and wallet-scoped nonce allocation

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: A transaction hash can be obtained before receipt polling times out, yet exception handling records REJECTED or leaves a position OPEN without durably retaining that hash. The unresolved transaction can later confirm while local eligibility permits another submission.
required_tests: Persist RECONCILING and transaction hash after send success followed by receipt timeout
Restart and reconcile successful and reverted transactions
Assert unresolved attempts prevent duplicate execution
decisions.title: Ambiguous EVM broadcasts lose transaction identity and may be retried

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: The per-user execution loop synchronously waits as long as 180 seconds for a receipt. This deterministically stalls subsequent dispatches and should be addressed together with durable asynchronous reconciliation.
required_tests: test_auto_trader_concurrency_non_blocking
test_auto_trader_slow_receipt_timeout
decisions.title: Synchronous receipt polling blocks subsequent user trades

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Pre/post RPC wallet snapshots can include unrelated transfers, rent changes, or concurrent transactions and therefore cannot deterministically attribute the entire delta to one trade. The precise replacement must be chain-specific and preserve gas, token, rent, and fee accounting.
required_tests: test_solana_pnl_receipt_parsing
test_evm_pnl_event_log_parsing
Verify unrelated concurrent balance changes are excluded from trade P&L
decisions.title: Trade P&L uses time-separated wallet balance snapshots

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Atomic file replacement does not make the preceding CSV read, validation, and mutation atomic. Concurrent callbacks or processes can redeem a single-use code more than once or overwrite user settings.
required_tests: Concurrent one-use activation redemption permits exactly one success
Concurrent user creation and setting updates lose no rows
Multi-process authorization locking test
decisions.title: Activation-code limits and user settings use unlocked read-modify-write operations

policy_reasons: HIGH/CRITICAL engineering change requires human review
decisions.reason: Fee submission is immediately reflected in net P&L without a confirmed settlement lifecycle, and no reconciliation path resolves broadcast or pending ledger entries. Dropped, replaced, reverted, or ambiguous transfers can therefore corrupt fee and user accounting.
required_tests: Cover confirmed, reverted, dropped, timed-out, and failed-before-send fee transfers
Reconcile gross P&L, user-net P&L, accrued fees, and paid fees independently
Verify restart recovery cannot charge a fee twice
decisions.title: Profit-share liabilities are treated as paid before confirmation

decisions.reason: Report rendering invokes evaluation writes, while cache-cold lookup can increment versions and reset existing lifecycle status. This violates read-only expectations, can weaken lifecycle throttling, and causes unbounded decision-history growth.
required_tests: Repeated report rendering produces no database writes
Restart or cache loss does not change strategy version or status
A new version is created only when the canonical specification changes
Decision history is deduplicated or subject to safe bounded retention
decisions.title: Strategy Lab reports mutate lifecycle state and append duplicate decisions

decisions.reason: The five-minute matrix workflow performs full-history checkout and repeated unpinned provider CLI and dependency installation before checking lane controls or unchanged-report signatures. This creates avoidable model cost, bandwidth, disk, and runner pressure. Host-wide network traffic must not be attributed solely to the bot.
required_tests: Unchanged reports skip provider CLI and dependency installation
Disabled lanes create no matrix worker
Measure per-run downloaded bytes, cache growth, and retained worktrees
Verify optimizations preserve every trading and safety gate
decisions.title: Scheduled adjudication performs expensive setup before material-change gates

decisions.reason: Infrastructure conclusion is BENCHMARK. There are zero observed seven-day trades and zero high-resolution execution samples; current provider, region, monthly cost, candidate pricing, chain trade share, and same-workload candidate benefit are UNKNOWN. RPC round-trip observations alone do not establish trading benefit or justify MOVE.
required_tests: Collect at least five current high-resolution execution samples
Benchmark the same workload stage-by-stage on candidate infrastructure
Compare monthly cost, chain-weighted trade share, execution outcomes, slippage, and realised P&L
decisions.title: Infrastructure migration lacks sufficient workload evidence

summary: Adjudication accepts eight execution, reconciliation, accounting, concurrency, persistence, and operational-efficiency findings. Execution-state and accounting fixes require human review because they affect safety-critical trading paths. No live, capital, wallet, signing, deployment, or repository change is authorized.
